items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Mary directly; the name 'Mary' is only mentioned by Speaker_05 in reference to her husband's band affiliation, with no personal interaction or relationship described between the interviewee and Mary.

ctx.x: Where'd you sign up in New York somewhere?

But, he's been in New York for a very long time. You know, as a young fellow. He's done very well. He was with, um, whose name was that? The same thing Mary's husband was with. His last name starts with an H. Not Heinz. Let's see.
Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins. Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins.
